feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence mappings showing which frontend files implement two UI features along with linked components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten descriptions summarizing major frontend components and pages, detailing functionality and design behavior across the app.

frontend/src/components/admin/ReportsExp: Generates PDF-formatted reports for bookings, customers, or properties based on selected filters and date ranges.
